attributes.morphology: cells developed along growth direction with shortened, poorly aligned Cr plates curled toward cell boundary

evidence.quote: The length of plate-like Cr phase in NiAl matrix became short and the morphology changed from a lamellar microstructure to a cellular eutectic microstructure.

attributes.morphology: shortened Cr plates, nearly rod-like Cr phases

evidence.quote: The increase in Ti-content further induced the shortening of Cr-phase plates and the eutectic microstructure containing nearly rod-like Cr phases was developed in 5Ti-alloy.
Precipitates with spherical shape are seen in all the alloys. They were identified to be the Cr(Mo) phases by EDS analysis

Yield stress (MPa) 619 699 1091 1269 1479
Approximately 5% of compressive plastic strain was obtained in 0Ti-alloy, but decreased to a few percent in Ti-bearing alloys.
The fracture toughness of 0Ti-alloy shows relatively high value of over 8 MPa m1/2 when the stress is loaded perpendicular to the growth direction.
Even in the 3Ti-alloy specimens, the fracture toughness rapidly decreases to about 4 MPa m1/2.
The fracture toughness of 5Ti-alloy showed the low value of about 4 MPa m 1/2 because of the disturbance of microstructure.
Since no specific precipitation was observed in 3Ti-alloy, the increase in yield stress of 3Ti-alloy must be caused by solution hardening.
the yield stress of 5Ti-alloys maintains much higher value than others up to 1200 C, demonstrating the effectiveness of Ni2AlTi phase in improving the high-temperature strength.

mechanisms.name: crack deflection by lamellar interface delamination

evidence.quote: the suppression of rapid propagation of cracks induces the frequent occurrence of debonding of the lamellar interface, called delamination... This induces the deflection of crack perpendicular to the loading direction, resulting in effective increase in fracture toughness.

mechanisms.name: loss of Cr-phase toughening due to microstructural disturbance

evidence.quote: the crack deflection did not occur macroscopically since the Cr plates were not well aligned along the growth direction and their length was not enough. Therefore, the toughening mechanism by Cr phase did not perform effectively
